accepted_by_user_id.description: the person who signed the version

basis.description: why the value is what it is, in one line: the lesson and the jobs it rests on, or the source of a first value

currency.description: the currency of every amount on this record (`value`, when `kind` is a money rate), an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code. A record with no currency has no usable amount. Absent for a norm or a percentage.

evidence_fact_ids.description: the facts the value rests on, at least one

jobs.description: the job references behind the value, for a reader who does not follow the fact ids

kind.description: what the value is: a unit rate, a productivity norm (hours per unit), or an allowance

lesson_id.description: the lesson that produced this version, when one did

state.description: whether this version is the one in force

unit.description: the unit of `value`, as the estimator states it (`h/m2`, `$/h`, `%`)

value.description: the input's value at this version, in `unit`

version.description: the version number, from 1, counted per organisation, work activity and kind

work_activity.description: the work activity the input prices, in the organisation's own activity vocabulary
